aizen.Pressure Stack: Accumulated through various attacks; Techniques, Counter and last hit of Basic Attack.
aizen.Ravage: Releasing the Battlefield Skill Hado 90: Kurohitsugi or counterattacks inflicts Ravage to the enemy, reducing their All-Type Resistance for 18 seconds.
aizen.Spiritual Pressure Intimidation: Releasing Ultimate, or releasing any Battlefield Skills or landing the  last strike of the basic attack upon reaching 3 Pressure Stacks, will activate Spiritual Pressure Intimidation. During this time, interruption resitance is increased, and Perfect Dodge is auto-triggered on most imminent attacks. All Pressure Stacks gained are converted into Enhanced Pressure Stacks.
aizen.Illusion Shield: Significantly increases interruption resistance. Taking any damage consumes 1 stack to negate it and grants Invincibility for 1 second.
aizen.Kyokasuigetsu: After releasing his Ultimate, Aizen enters Kyokasuigetsu, enhancing his basic attacks and backline Battlefield Skills.
aizen.Enhanced Pressure Stacks: During Spiritual Domination, all Pressure Stacks gained by Aizen are converted into Enhanced Pressure Stacks. Releasing the Battlefield Skill Hado 90: Kurohitsugi consumes all Enhanced Pressure Stacks, granting shields to the team and counterattack effects when switching characters.
aizen.Suppression Gauge: Suppression Gauge is accumulated when other teammates attack. When the Suppression Gauge reaches its maximum, enters Complete Suppression. During this time, releasing a backline Battlefield Skill consumes all Suppression Gauge to increase its damage. The damage boost effect is further increased while Kyokasuigetsu is active.
aizen.True Time Freeze: Pauses time countdown of the stage. Timers for all buffs and states on characters and enemies will be stopped.

chad.2nd Follow-up Attack: At the highest Bump DMG stage or when you release the basic attack button in advance, Chad will immediately launch a follow-up attack.

gin.Technique Points: When Gin charges and releases his Technique, he constantly consumes Technique Points to boost its power. Recovers 1 Technique Point every 10 seconds. Can be stacked up to 3 points.
gin.affected by debuffs: Ongoing debuffs include Freeze, Wound, Cleave, and Verde Rush.
